shortDescription: Manages load balancers on the cloudscale.ch IaaS service

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for calls to the cloudscale.ch API. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TIMEOUT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: cloudscale.ch API token. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: api_url
options.description: cloudscale.ch API URL. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_URL) environment variable.

options.name: delay_s
options.description: The delay between two successive checks in seconds.

options.name: down_threshold
options.description: The number of checks that need to fail before the monitor_status of a pool member changes to "down".

options.name: http
options.description: Advanced options for health monitors with type "http" or "https".

options.name: pool
options.description: The pool of the health monitor.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the load balancer health monitor.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags assosiated with the load balancer. Set this to C({}) to clear any tags.

options.name: timeout_s
options.description: The maximum time allowed for an individual check in seconds.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of the health monitor. See the [API documentation](https://www.cloudscale.ch/en/api/v1#create-a-health-monitor) for allowed options.

options.name: up_threshold
options.description: The number of checks that need to be successful before the monitor_status of a pool member changes to "up".

options.name: uuid
options.description: UUID of the load balancer health monitor.
